data.one_liner: Loading widget based on a custom Flare animation
data.what_it_does: Provides a loading widget and dialog powered by custom Flare animations. It handles transitions between start, loop, and end animations depending on initialization progress or state flags.
use_when: You are using Flare animations for loading screens or dialogs in your app
You want to manage start, loop, and end states of an animation based on a Future or boolean
avoid_when: You are using Rive instead of Flare (use rive_loading instead)
You do not use Flare animations
strengths: Simplifies complex multi-state loading animations (intro, loop, end)
Supports callbacks for success and error handling
weaknesses: Relies on Flare, which is an older format (Rive is its successor)
Not documented beyond basic usage parameters
